The '''Battle of Tosste''' was a battle that commenced in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] as part of the [[Western Reaches Operation]] during the [[Reconquest of the Rim]]. [[Shea Hublin]]'s [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] defeated the [[Iska pirates/Legends|pirate]] lord [[Guun Cutlax]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
